title: Certify a nuisance phase on the unit circle without phase gridding
statement: For F(z)=A+zB+z^-1 B*, a Toeplitz T(z) and explicit block PSD Gram X certify each sign through [I,zI]* X [I,zI]. Exact rational realification/LDL and residual bounds yield r_safe=r+max_blocks(2 delta+e0+2e1). The final input is the exact canonical Hermitian part of ORIGINAL supplied binary64 A, not a rounded symmetrization. Raw probability error is r_safe/2; the declared normalized5^3 nonzero probability coefficient has additional factor(1+sqrt5)/5.
